system.description: Armor Class: 6 Hit Dice: 5* (L) Move: 150' (50') Attacks: 2 claws or 1 boulder Damage: 2d4/2d4 or 2d8 No. Appearing: 0(ld10) Save As: F5 Morale: 6 or 11 (see below) Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 6 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 300 Monster Type: Humanoid (Rare). The sasquatch are a very shy race of low intelligence who dwell deep within dark woods and in high mountains. The creature is a tall apelike creature with a crested head, large feet, and a thick mat of hair (dark brown in woods, white in mountains).
